function: An inline frame is marked up as follows.

attributes.name: allow
attributes.function: Specifies a feature policy for the <iframe>

attributes.name: allowfullscreen
attributes.function: Set to true if the <iframe> can activate fullscreen mode by calling the requestFullscreen() method

attributes.name: allowpaymentrequest
attributes.function: Set to true if a cross-origin <iframe> should be allowed to invoke the Payment Request API

attributes.name: height
attributes.function: Specifies the height of an <iframe>. Default height is 150 pixels

attributes.name: loading
attributes.function: Specifies whether a browser should load an iframe immediately or to defer loading of iframes until some conditions are met

attributes.name: referrerpolicy
attributes.values: no-referrer | no-referrer-when-downgrade | origin | origin-when-cross-origin | same-origin | strict-origin-when-cross-origin | unsafe-url
attributes.function: Specifies which referrer information to send when fetching the iframe

attributes.name: sandbox
attributes.values: allow-forms | allow-pointer-lock | allow-popups | allow-same-origin | allow-scripts | allow-top-navigation
attributes.function: Enables an extra set of restrictions for the content in an <iframe>

attributes.name: src
attributes.function: Specifies the address of the document to embed in the <iframe>

attributes.name: srcdoc
attributes.function: Specifies the HTML content of the page to show in the <iframe>

attributes.name: width
attributes.function: Specifies the width of an <iframe>. Default width is 300 pixels
